title: createclientendpoint
description: Verify that the create client API endpoint successfully creates a new PF or PJ client with correct tenant isolation and stores client history.

title: viewclientprofileendpoint
description: Verify that the view client profile API endpoint returns the complete and accurate client profile data for the authenticated tenant.

title: updateclientstatusendpoint
description: Verify that the update client status API endpoint correctly updates the status of a client and maintains tenant isolation.

title: moveprocesscardendpoint
description: Verify that the API endpoint for moving a process card between stages updates the process status correctly and reflects urgency indicators.

title: addprocessupdateendpoint
description: Verify that the add process update API endpoint successfully adds updates to a legal process and associates them with the correct process and tenant.

title: filterprocessesendpoint
description: Verify that the filter processes API endpoint correctly filters legal processes by tribunal or area for the authenticated tenant.

title: recordpaymentendpoint
description: Verify that the record payment API endpoint accurately records income or expense payments and associates them with the correct tenant.

title: generatefinancialstatsendpoint
description: Verify that the generate financial stats API endpoint returns correct income, expense, and profit statistics for the authenticated tenant.

title: exportpdfreportendpoint
description: Verify that the export PDF report API endpoint generates and returns an accurate financial report PDF for the tenant's data.

title: loginendpoint
description: Verify that the login API endpoint authenticates users using JWT and enforces multi-tenancy and 2FA security requirements.
